title: acer mono subsp. mayrii
intro: Acer mono subsp. mayrii, commonly known as Mayrii Japanese Maple, is a subspecies of the Japanese maple tree (Acer mono) native to Japan. It is a deciduous tree known for its distinctive leaves and vibrant autumn colors, which have been used in traditional Japanese medicine for their health benefits. The leaves and bark of Mayrii Japanese Maple have been used to treat various health issues, including fever, digestive problems, and inflammation, due to their therapeutic actions of cooling, purging, and calming the body. The bioactive constituents of Mayrii Japanese Maple include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
